source_record_subset.pg: SELECT "t1"."account_id" FROM "loan" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "account" AS "t2" ON "t1"."account_id" = "t2"."account_id" WHERE TO_CHAR( CAST( "t2"."date" AS TIMESTAMP ) , 'YYYY' ) = '1993' AND "t1"."duration" > 12 ORDER BY "t1"."amount" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT `t1`.`account_id` FROM `loan` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `account` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`account_id` = `t2`.`account_id` WHERE YEAR(CAST(`t2`.`date` AS DATE)) = 1993 AND `t1`.`duration` > 12 ORDER BY `t1`.`amount` DESC LIMIT 1
